readerJob: Decide whether the newly announced 14-inch Core 5 Galaxy Book6 suits a portable creator workflow and which equipment or evidence is still needed.
decision: Shortlist the announced 16 GB/512 GB configuration for light writing, calls and connected-phone workflows only. Do not recommend purchase, sustained editing or local AI until an exact Dutch orderable SKU and independent workload evidence are checked.
wrongPurchaseConditions: Confusing the September Core 5 expansion with the February Core Ultra 5 Galaxy Book6 14, or importing global Core 3, color and price options into the Dutch offer.
Treating Samsung's up-to-25-hour battery figure as tested creator-workload endurance.
Choosing 8 GB for memory-heavy multitasking without testing the exact workload.
Assuming USB4, Thunderbolt, external SSD speed, calibrated display quality or sustained rendering performance from the published port and display list.
Planning a 4K external monitor above 30 Hz through the stated HDMI 1.4 output.
